## Context / immutable basis
This reconciler-test cohort contains 44 confirmed bloated prose blocks across exactly 8 file-impact paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

The inventory and before-citations are pinned to `origin/main@d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1`. A path-scoped comparison through `9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45` found identical blobs. Implement from current `origin/main`; keep d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1 as the immutable before side. This leaf is one commit, so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Editing boundary and semantic guard
Edit only allowlisted comments/docstrings plus adjacent blank lines. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged. Rewrite stale RED/pre-fix language as current contracts.

For every path, parse immutable and final source with `ast.parse(source, type_comments=True)`; recursively strip only a leading `Expr(Constant(str))` from each `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, and `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` equality. A tokenizer guard separately preserves directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 44 editable blocks
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_outbound_differ_rebar_id_exclusion.py` (2) — module and test_outbound_differ_excludes_colon_form_rebar_id_label docstrings. Preserve colon-form bridge-label exclusion without masking real outbound differences.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_outbound_effective_map_cache_d378.py` (1) — module docstring beginning “Per-project effective-map memoization…”. Preserve one discovery per distinct project, project-keyed mapping, and unchanged create output.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_parent_clear_bidirectional_37e7.py` (9) — module; _FakeBindingStore, _local_tickets, _remote_fields, _snapshot, and _run_outbound docstrings; all three test docstrings. Preserve real inbound/outbound composition, peer-parent evidence, remote de-parenting, suppression of peer removals, local re-set propagation, and final inbound clear.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_parent_clear_requires_peer_evidence.py` (6) — module, _FakeBindingStore, and _child docstrings; docstrings of test_a_parent_the_peer_never_had_is_not_cleared, test_a_parent_the_peer_once_had_is_cleared, and test_an_unobserved_parent_is_never_cleared_even_with_peer_evidence. Preserve positive peer evidence, observed-empty versus unobserved parent state, local-only parent safety, and legitimate clear behavior.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_parent_detach_sync.py` (2) — module and test_unmanaged_jira_parent_is_not_cleared docstrings. Preserve managed-ref-gated detach propagation and protection of human-managed Jira parents.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_parent_drop_parity_8390.py` (11) — module, _tickets, _alert_kinds, and _update_drop docstrings; docstrings of the bound-drop, unbound-control, epic-parent, no-sink, ACLI-400-recording, ACLI-400-swallowing, and converged-vs-dropped tests. Preserve create/update parity, bound versus unbound/epic parents, durable divergence alerts, optional sinks, 400-only soft failure, and unchanged convergence discrimination.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_parent_emit_suppression_is_loud_9f26.py` (8) — module and _remote docstrings; docstrings of the suppressed, already-converged, divergent, unbound-non-epic, epic-parent, and bridge-alert-store tests. Preserve operator-visible suppression only for real dropped fields, negative controls, accepted parent emission, optional observability, and end-to-end alert persistence.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_snapshot_differ_stale_local_state.py` (5) — module docstring; docstrings of test_a_converged_pair_plans_no_outbound_update_after_our_own_write, test_a_key_that_left_the_fetch_window_plans_no_outbound_create, test_a_genuinely_new_remote_key_still_plans_its_inbound_create, and test_seed_mutations_survive_the_suppression. Preserve stale-local-state suppression, non-vacuous differ preconditions, departed-window safety, genuine inbound creates, and invariant seed preservation.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest directly collects every impacted module; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or doctest consumer was found. Six protected directive tokens: # type: ignore[union-attr] in outbound_rebar_id, parent_detach, parent_drop, and parent_emit_suppression; snapshot_stale_local_state also has that token and # pragma: no cover - import bootstrap. Preserve each complete directive token and its attached executable statement exactly.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the prose change must post exactly 44 leaf-linked TSV rows, one per edited block:
`path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session`

Both verdicts are `PASS`, citations use full SHAs, and every after count is lower. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 44 allowlisted prose blocks or adjacent blank lines change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and states only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints.
- [ ] Normalized AST dumps are exactly equal between d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1 and final `HEAD`.
- [ ] Protected directive text and attachment are exact; runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] Sorted paths changed by the one leaf commit `HEAD^..HEAD` exactly equal all 8 file-impact paths.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has exactly 44 passing rows with full before/final SHAs.
- [ ] Path-scoped diff integrity, comment hygiene, and pytest over every impacted file pass.
- [ ] Worktree-venv `make verify` passes without a timeout.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: `semantic`, `directives`, `paths`, `diff`, `hygiene`, `focused`, and `full`. Executable guards prove behavior/directive/path preservation; the TSV decides each block’s semantic preservation and bloat removal.
